Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR) for sex chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
DNA extracted from cultured amniotic fluid cells. QF-PCR performed using fluorescently labeled primers for sex chromosome markers including AMELX/Y, SRY, and X-linked STR markers.
